description: A blind 2 mm hole drilled 10.5 mm from 0.5 mm behind the flat back of a 452 mm D-profile bar (flat back 9.2 wide at x = -7.4, half-round front R 4.6 reaching x = 4.6). The hole ends at x = 2.6, 2 mm inside the material and clear of the round face, but the cut was refused: the exact fallback takes planar faces only, and the nudged tool gave an implausible volume (#544). The same cut works on a 350 mm bar. Result: the bar less pi * 1^2 * 10 mm3.
